world.title: 此刻，整座太阳系
world.posterTitle: 八大行星此刻都在哪里？
world.posterHook: 任选一天，点任意行星跟拍：此刻它们各自在哪条轨道上。
world.question: 八大行星此刻都在哪里？
world.hook: 把时间流速拨快，看内行星一年年超越外侧的巨行星；点击任意天体，跟拍它的卫星、光环与晨昏线。
world.payoff: 同一份开普勒轨道根数驱动整个系统：每颗行星都在坠落中错过中心，于是整座太阳系像钟表一样精密——你可以把它拨到过去或未来的任何一天。

en.title: The solar system, right now
en.posterTitle: Where are the eight planets right now?
en.posterHook: Pick any day and follow any planet: see where each one sits on its orbit right now.
en.question: Where are the eight planets right now?
en.hook: Crank up the time rate to watch inner planets overtake the outer giants year after year; click any body to follow its moons, rings and terminator.
en.payoff: One set of Keplerian elements drives the whole system: every planet keeps missing the center as it falls, so the solar system runs like clockwork — rewind or fast-forward it to any day you like.
